title: The shape of a working season
description: Weekly hours by workstream across twelve weeks and twenty-four fictional documents. One stacked area chart, adapted for a presentation from the welcome guide’s synthetic dataset.
alt: A single stacked area chart shows hours per week for research, drafting, design, and review across twelve weeks. Total effort peaks at 100 hours in week three.
sources: Original synthetic demonstration dataset authored for the OpenDoc welcome document, 11 September 2026. No project activity or product performance was measured.
attribution: Illustrative data only. This is not an OpenDoc productivity benchmark.
